## Summary

A short description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem it solves

What limitation or friction does this address? Why would it be useful?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you have in mind. Include UI sketches or API shapes if helpful.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about and why you prefer this one.

## Additional context

Links, references, or anything else that helps make the case.
